wiki.title: Sam Watson (politician)
wiki.extract: Samuel Lawrence Watson (born September 19, 1978) is an American politician from Georgia serving as a Republican member of the Georgia Senate, representing the 11th district. Watson was previously a member of the Georgia House of Representatives from 2013 to 2022. He resigned his house seat to run in a 2023 special election to replace retired senator Dean Burke.
